purpose: Generate a panel schedule (circuit directory with per-phase load totals and balance) in the standard Canadian commercial format.

header: voltage and system (e.g. 208Y/120 V 3-phase 4-wire, 600Y/347 V, 120/240 V 1-phase 3-wire)
main breaker rating or main lugs only (MLO)
per_circuit: circuit number (odd numbers down the left, even down the right, A-B-C phase rotation)
connected VA per phase (A / B / C columns)
summary: connected VA, kVA and amps per phase
demand load by load type with demand factors
demand amps vs main / bus rating with spare capacity

phase_assignment: 1-pole circuits rotate A, B, C; 2-pole circuits rotate AB, BC, CA and split their VA equally between the two phases; 3-pole circuits split VA equally across A, B, C. Circuit numbers follow the entered order; on a physical panel, odd numbers run down the left and even numbers down the right.
demand_factors_note: Demand factors are designer inputs (default 100%). This generator does not apply CEC Section 8 demand rules for you - enter the demand factor per load type that your design uses.
balance_note: Phase balance is reported as the spread between the highest and lowest phase VA as a percentage of the average; a common design target is within 10%.
